audit_items.proof_trace: `borrow_flash_loan` calls only `flash_loan_withdraw` (L318-324), which splits the dynamic-field `underlying_balance` without touching `self.debt`; the only function that increments `self.debt` is `borrow_amount` (L199), which is never invoked on this path. The hot-potato `ReserveFlashLoan` type enforces repayment in the same PTB via `repay_flash_loan`, which also leaves `self.debt` unchanged, proving the invariant `debt_before == debt_after` for every flash loan cycle.
